label: Curio synthetic visual-grammar corpus
disclosure: These are authored design-system examples for prompt conditioning. They are not scraped data, model training, or claims about any artist's work.

examples.name: Receipt ledger
examples.composition: dense left rail with a quiet right field and a small anchored footer
examples.typeSystem: condensed grotesk headline, tabular numerals, tiny monospace annotations
examples.shapeLanguage: receipt rules, crop marks, clipped blocks
examples.colorLogic: warm paper, ink black, one food-color accent
examples.rhythm: compressed information at the top, generous pause before details

examples.name: Sun slice
examples.composition: oversized diagonal wedge crossing the page with copy tucked under its edge
examples.typeSystem: friendly display serif paired with compact sans-serif labels
examples.shapeLanguage: soft arcs and offset paper slabs
examples.colorLogic: butter yellow, tomato, turquoise, dark plum
examples.rhythm: one dominant gesture, then short bursts of copy

examples.name: Window grid
examples.composition: asymmetric modular grid with one oversized empty cell
examples.typeSystem: wide grotesk headline with narrow body copy and numeric captions
examples.shapeLanguage: thin window rules, one solid corner block
examples.colorLogic: cool grey field, mineral green, warm orange signal
examples.rhythm: repeating modules interrupted by one deliberate gap

examples.name: Handbill burst
examples.composition: stacked type bursts from a low corner with a rotated event stamp
examples.typeSystem: heavy grotesk at three scales, condensed details, rotated microcopy
examples.colorLogic: ink black, signal red, faded cream, cobalt
examples.rhythm: hard jumps between scales rather than a smooth hierarchy

examples.name: Orbit diagram
examples.composition: small type nucleus with large off-canvas orbital geometry
examples.typeSystem: geometric sans-serif with widely tracked metadata
examples.colorLogic: deep blue field, acid chartreuse, pale lavender

examples.name: Cut-up archive
examples.composition: overlapping cards with text split across two unrelated alignments
examples.typeSystem: expressive serif title, neutral sans body, tiny archival index
examples.shapeLanguage: paper cards, masking bands, uneven crop windows
examples.colorLogic: aged white, oxblood, dusty blue, graphite
examples.rhythm: layered and tactile, with visible overlaps

examples.name: Kinetic staircase
examples.composition: headline steps across the page while details counter-step below
examples.typeSystem: bold italic grotesk with compressed utility text
examples.shapeLanguage: short bars, stair-step blocks, sharp underlines
examples.colorLogic: electric violet, citrus, black, soft grey
examples.rhythm: repeated offset increments create motion without centering

examples.name: Quiet monument
examples.composition: single tall text column balanced by a low horizontal anchor
examples.typeSystem: high-contrast serif with restrained small caps
examples.shapeLanguage: one hairline, one measured block, no decorative circle
examples.rhythm: large quiet field and precise small details

examples.name: Signal stack
examples.composition: oversized title cropped by the frame with details pinned to opposing edges
examples.typeSystem: variable-width grotesk, compressed label row, mono coordinates
examples.shapeLanguage: hard bars, scan lines, one offset notch
examples.colorLogic: near-black, hot coral, pale mint, ultraviolet

examples.name: Table map
examples.composition: wide table-like grid with the headline occupying a side seat
examples.typeSystem: humanist sans headline, menu-style labels, handwritten accent only for one word
examples.shapeLanguage: table cells, rounded tabs, ingredient-like dots
examples.rhythm: ordered rows with one playful interruption

examples.name: Poster as object
examples.composition: small centered information surrounded by an oversized cropped object
examples.typeSystem: neutral grotesk with one enormous low-weight word
examples.shapeLanguage: one abstract object, hard crop, thin registration marks
examples.colorLogic: generated from the brief's most specific color cue
examples.rhythm: deliberate imbalance and an unexpected empty corner
